_app_note: Your app. bundle_id is what devicectl launches; process_name is what the process is called on the phone (often not the bundle's last component, and the App Store and in-house builds of one app usually differ). Leave either empty and pass --bundle / --process on the command line instead.
_release_console_env_note: Many in-house loggers write to the app's console in Debug builds only, and offer an opt-in os_log echo for Release builds behind an environment variable. Name it here and `capture.sh device-console --release-echo` sets it at launch. Empty means your app has no such switch, and a Release build then carries nothing on either channel - see references/channels.md.
_log_line_note: The header your logger prints, as an extended regex. The default matches the common in-house shape `[2026-08-26 -7.0 15:39:15.140][6118:4401720656*][I][SomeTag][file,func,line] message` - timestamp, pid:tid (a trailing * marking the main thread), a single-letter level, a module tag. analyze.sh's summary / errors / tag / main all key off it; if your logger looks different, change this and the three field patterns below.
